'''Koozebane''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" />

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
It was visited by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who together fought against a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] on the planet.<ref name="Insider 32">{{InsiderCite|32|Caravan of Courage: Star Wars on Television|''Caravan of Courage'': ''Star Wars'' on Television}}</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}

==Behind the scenes==
This planet first appeared in [[W:c:muppet:The Muppets Valentine Show|''The Muppets Valentine Show'']], a predecessor to ''[[The Muppet Show]]'' which aired in [[1974]]. Koozebane appeared frequently in sketches involving humorously strange aliens, most notably the Koozebanians and their bizarre mating ritual. It was later referenced in the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' articles ''[[Caravan of Courage: Star Wars on Television]]'' and ''[[Star Wars on The Muppet Show]]'', and confirmed as a part of ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.
